department.en: Revenue Department, Govt of NCT of Delhi

summary.en: Register a birth and get the certificate from the local body (MCD, NDMC or Delhi Cantonment Board).
summary.hi: जन्म का पंजीकरण कराएँ और स्थानीय निकाय (MCD, NDMC या दिल्ली छावनी बोर्ड) से प्रमाण पत्र पाएँ।
summary.hn: Birth register karayein aur local body (MCD, NDMC ya Delhi Cantonment Board) se certificate payein.

text.en: An official birth certificate issued by the local body (MCD, NDMC or Delhi Cantonment Board).
Every birth must be reported and registered within 21 days at the place where it occurred. A hospital reports its own births; for a birth at home the head of the family reports it.
Registration after 21 days but within 30 days needs a late fee of ₹2. After a month but within one year it needs the Registrar's written permission and a fee of ₹5.

After one year, a Birth Registration Order is needed. It is for a citizen of India or NRI born in Delhi who has no birth certificate from any government agency in India, applying at least one year after the birth.

For the Birth Registration Order (late registration): identity proof of the person and, for a minor, of the parents; present and permanent address proof; date of birth proof; place of birth proof (hospital report, or the parents' address proof for a home birth).
A notarised affidavit on ₹10 non-judicial e-stamp paper in the prescribed format, and one colour passport size photo (5 cm x 4.5 cm).
Additional copies are ₹5 each. Searching one entry in the current year costs ₹2, plus ₹2 for each additional year searched. The fee for the first copy is not stated: verify locally.
Within 7 days of receiving your application, if the birth is already registered.

Report the birth within 21 days to the Registrar of Births and Deaths of your local body: an MCD zonal office or vaccination centre, an NDMC vaccination centre, or the Delhi Cantonment registration centre.
Apply for the certificate at the registration centre or zonal office of that local body.
If the birth was never registered and a year has passed, apply for a Birth Registration Order with the documents listed.
